explanation: A judge and military leader in Israel whom God chose to save the Israelites from the Midianites.
A people group who oppressed and plundered the Israelites, and whom Gideon was called to fight against.
Another judge and military leader in Israel who fought against the Canaanites.
The place where Gideon gathered his soldiers before the battle against the Midianites.
A test Gideon performed to assure himself that God was with him in the fight against the Midianites.
The small number of soldiers God chose for Gideon to use in the battle against the Midianites to show His power and strength.
A dream one of the Midianites had, which Gideon heard, and which he interpreted as a sign that God would give him victory.
Objects carried by the 300 men along with torches and trumpets, which they broke and blew to create fear and confusion among the enemy.
The result of the battle where Gideon and his 300 men overcame the Midianites with God's help.
